text.value:
UPDATE dbo.audit_log
SET status = 'SUCCESS',
    end_time = SYSUTCDATETIME(),
    records_read = @{activity('Source To Landing Ingestion').output.rowsRead},
    records_written = @{int(coalesce(activity('Get Silver Notebook Result').output.properties.exitValue,'0'))}
WHERE adf_run_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.adf_run_id}'
  AND table_id = @{pipeline().parameters.table_id};
